name: Herreros de Suso (Spain)
description: Square flag gyronny of red and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Herreros de Suso (a tower, flames and a lion).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 10 September 1993 (Boletín Oficial del Estado no. 305 of 22 December 1993); the flag is square, gyronny of red and yellow, with the municipal arms in their colours at the centre.

features.role: Herreros de Suso arms — tower, flames and lion
